additional.title: 中華民國憲法增修條文 (Additional Articles of the Constitution of the Republic of China), as amended 10 June 2005
additional.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Laws and Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
additional.note: Arts. 1 and 12 (constitutional amendments and territorial changes ratified by referendum of the free area, the National Assembly's articles suspended), 2 (direct election of the president and vice president on one ticket from the ninth term in 1996, plurality), 4 (113 legislators from the seventh term, four-year term: 73 single-member district seats, 3 lowland and 3 highland indigenous seats, 34 at-large and overseas seats by party list with a 5 percent threshold), 7 (Control Yuan nominated by the president), and 9 (provincial government appointed).

csera.title: 公職人員選舉罷免法 (Civil Servants Election and Recall Act), as amended to 1 July 2026
csera.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Laws and Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
csera.note: Arts. 2 (offices elected: legislators, special municipality, county and city councillors and heads, township and mountain indigenous district representatives and heads, village chiefs), 3 (single non-transferable vote, party list for at-large and overseas seats), 35-37 (constituencies), 39 (election at least ten days before the term ends; sixty days after a dissolution), 67 (plurality; party-list allocation), 68 (women's reserved seats), 70 (20 percent of electors for an unopposed head), 73 (legislative by-elections within three months), 76 and 90 (recall: 1 percent to propose, carried with more yes than no votes and yes votes at least a quarter of electors).

pvpera.title: 總統副總統選舉罷免法 (Presidential and Vice Presidential Election and Recall Act), as amended to 19 August 2026
pvpera.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Laws and Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
pvpera.note: Enacted 9 August 1995; the election is announced 120 days before the term ends and held at least 30 days before it ends.

referendum_act.title: 公民投票法 (Referendum Act), as amended to 3 December 2025
referendum_act.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Laws and Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
referendum_act.note: National and local referendums; Art. 23 (held three to six months after a proposal is certified, on the day of a national election when one falls in that window), Art. 29 (carried with more yes than no votes and yes votes at least a quarter of electors).

lga.title: 地方制度法 (Local Government Act), as amended to 3 December 2025
lga.publisher: Ministry of Justice, Laws and Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

classes.finest_note: 1996 published by township (district seats) and nationally (indigenous seats); 2005 by polling station.
classes.note: The First National Assembly was elected across China in November 1947; Taiwan's members were added by the 1969 supplementary and the additional elections of 1972, 1980, and 1986, and the Second National Assembly was elected in full in December 1991. The Third (1996) had district, indigenous, and party-list at-large and overseas seats. The 2000 revision made the Assembly an ad hoc body; the only one, elected by party list on 14 May 2005, ratified the 2005 revision that abolished it.

classes.note: Any directly elected official except party-list legislators can be recalled after a year in office by the electors of the original constituency; carried with more yes than no votes and yes votes from a quarter of electors (CSERA Arts. 76 and 90; the presidential recall is in the Presidential Act and has never reached a vote). classes.name: 政黨提名初選
classes.disposition_reason: Parties choose their nominees by their own member votes and commissioned telephone polls; no election law governs them and the Central Election Commission neither runs nor publishes them.

classes.name: 監察委員選舉
classes.name_en: Control Yuan elections by provincial and municipal councils
classes.note: Members were elected by the provincial and special municipality councils (Constitution Art. 91): nationwide in 1948, then Taiwan's additional members by the Taiwan Provincial Assembly and the Taipei and Kaohsiung councils from 1973 to 1987, and the Second Control Yuan in 1992. Since 1993 members are nominated by the president with the Legislative Yuan's consent (Additional Articles Art. 7).
classes.disposition_reason: The councils' votes are recorded only in their printed proceedings; neither the Central Election Commission nor the Control Yuan publishes them, and no official copy is online.

classes.name: 農會、漁會選任人員選舉
classes.disposition_reason: Farmers' and fishermen's associations are membership bodies: members elect representatives, who elect directors and supervisors; the associations run the votes under the agriculture authority's supervision and publish no official returns.

classes.name: 農田水利會會長、會務委員選舉
classes.disposition_reason: Members of the 17 irrigation associations elected their chairs and representatives (last in 2018) in votes the associations ran themselves; the Irrigation Act of 2020 turned them into public agencies with appointed heads.

classes.name: 臺灣省長選舉
classes.note: Held once, on 3 December 1994; the 1997 revision froze provincial elections and the governor became an appointee from 21 December 1998 (Additional Articles Art. 9).

classes.name: 臺灣省議員選舉

Abolished on 21 December 1998.
